title: Cut The Buttons
description: Cut The Buttons is a creative puzzle game that challenges logic and trains the brain. With stunning graphics and simple controls, its a highly engaging puzzle game that appeals to players of all ages.
instructions: 1 Use the mouse or finger to control 2 Select a button with the mouse as the starting point 3 Cut same-colored buttons on the same line 4 You cant cut the line with different-colored buttons 5 Dont leave any buttons at the end of the level
